conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Revenue Officer James Peterson, badge number 418762. Who am I speaking with?
This is Margaret Hill. I got a message saying something was wrong with my taxes?

Yes, Mrs. Hill, I'm calling about urgent discrepancies in your federal payroll tax submission for the last two quarters. This is a compliance matter involving IRS Section 7201. Are you aware of these issues?
No, I only do some bookkeeping from home. I don't know about payroll taxes. I'm retired.

According to our records, your Social Security number is tied to a small business account with unreported 1099 income and missing tax documents. If this is not resolved, it could be considered tax evasion under federal law.
Oh my, no, I had no idea! I just help a few neighbors sometimes. I can't lose my Social Security.

Mrs. Hill, this is very serious. Non-compliance with IRS filing requirements triggers immediate review. If you fail to act, your assets, accounts, and federal benefits could be frozen within 24 hours.
Please, I can't have that happen. What do I need to do?
Right now, you must verify your case to prevent formal enforcement. I will need you to confirm your last four digits of your Social Security number and your current bank balance.
My last four are 1123. I don't have much in my account, maybe a few hundred dollars.

Thank you. I am inputting your details. Based on your case, you are facing a penalty of $2,100 for non-filing and late taxes. If payment is not received immediately, the IRS will initiate asset forfeiture, including suspension of your Medicare.
No, please, I can't lose Medicare. I need it for my medicine.

This matter is time-sensitive. To avoid a federal lien and criminal charges, you must settle the penalty right now. We are not authorized to accept checks for urgent compliance. You will need to purchase government-approved electronic payment vouchers.
I don't understand. What kind of vouchers?

You must go to your local pharmacy or supermarket and buy prepaid debit cards, Visa or Mastercard, totaling $2,100. Remain on the line while you get the cards. This is the only way to pause enforcement today.
I'm not sure I have that much. Can you give me a little time?
Mrs. Hill, if you delay even one hour, our system will automatically escalate your case to the Department of Justice. You could be subject to arrest or lose your monthly income. Do not hang up.
Alright, I'll go to the store. Please don't let anything bad happen.
Good. As soon as you have the cards, read me the numbers and the codes on the back. I will stay on this call until you finish. This is for your protection.
I'm leaving now. It might take a little while to get there.
That's fine. Remember, if you speak to anyone at the store, do not mention the IRS. This is a confidential compliance matter. If you disclose details, the system may flag your account for fraud.
Alright, I won't say anything. I just want this to be over.
Once you buy the prepaid cards, come back to a private location and read the numbers to me. Failure to comply completely and quickly could result in forfeiture of all federal benefits. Is that clear?
Yes, I understand. I'll call you when I have the cards.
